title: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced LLMs: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying evaluation methods and datasets like OffsetBias that use attribute-controlled prompts and multi-model outputs to systematically measure structural model preferences, such as length/verbosity bias, style bias, concreteness bias, and informativeness bias.

Reviewing literature on the limitations of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and analyzing how AI feedback (RLAIF) utilizing Chain-of-Thought reasoning is used to reduce subjective human evaluation biases.
